title: BIM Execution Plan
when_to_use: Every section ISO 19650-2 asks for, at tender and after appointment. Use it when several task teams deliver or the client issued an EIR.

sections.heading: 1. Project information
sections.guidance: Name the project, the appointing party, the lead appointed party and the main dates, so a reader knows what this plan covers. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2)

sections.heading: 2. Response to the EIR
sections.guidance: Say how this plan answers the exchange information requirements: what you answer, what you assume and what you need the client to clarify. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.2.1 and 5.3.2)

sections.heading: 3. Information delivery team and responsibilities
sections.guidance: List the key people and task teams and who is responsible for producing each kind of information. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2 a and d)

sections.heading: 4. Information delivery strategy
sections.guidance: Describe how and when information is delivered against the project milestones. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2 b)

sections.heading: 5. Federation strategy
sections.guidance: Explain how the models are split and put together, and how the split follows the breakdown of the project. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2 c)

sections.heading: 6. Common data environment and workflow
sections.guidance: Describe the common data environment, its states and how information moves through them. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.1.7)

sections.heading: 7. Information standard and container naming
sections.guidance: State the information standard that applies and the rule for naming information containers. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.3.2 f and 5.1.4)

sections.heading: 8. Level of information need
sections.guidance: Say how much geometry, detail and data each deliverable needs at each milestone. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.2.1)

sections.heading: 9. Production methods and procedures
sections.guidance: Set out the methods and procedures used to produce information, and any additions to the appointing party's. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.3.2 e and 5.1.5)

sections.heading: 10. Software, hardware and IT infrastructure
sections.guidance: List the software, hardware and IT the delivery team uses, with versions where they matter. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2 g)

sections.heading: 11. Quality assurance and model checking
sections.guidance: Describe how information is checked before it is shared or issued, and what a failed check leads to. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.6.3)

sections.heading: 12. Capability and capacity
sections.guidance: Show that the task teams have the capability and capacity to deliver the information required. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.3.3 and 5.3.4)

sections.heading: 13. Mobilisation
sections.guidance: Say how resources, information technology and the delivery team are made ready and tested before work starts. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.5)

sections.heading: 14. Information delivery risks
sections.guidance: Record the risks to delivering the information and how each is handled. (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.6)

sections.heading: 15. Delivery plans (MIDP and TIDP)
sections.guidance: Point to the master information delivery plan and the task information delivery plans that sit under it. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.4.4 and 5.4.5)

sections.heading: 16. Project documents
sections.guidance: List the documents this plan relies on, with their version and who issued them. (ISO 19650-2 clauses 5.1.4 to 5.1.6)

data.markdown: **The project is not yet following ISO 19650.** The appointing party has not issued exchange information requirements (EIR) with this tender. This pre-appointment BEP anticipates them (ISO 19650-2 clause 5.3.2), and we will agree the EIR with the appointing party before this BEP is confirmed.
